subject: ENGLISH
title: Choose an Ending · M01 D03
objective: Choose a logical story ending supported by earlier events.
introduction: Ana's seedling is dry! Help her choose an ending that really follows the story.

vocabulary.definition: The last part of a story that follows what happened.
A tale with characters and events.
A person or animal in a story.

activities.instruction: Watch how a good ending follows the story!
activities.content: A logical ending follows from the characters, problem, and events already shown.

feedback.retry: Find the clue in Choose an Ending again. 💪

activities.accessibilityAlternative: Text alternative: A logical ending follows from the characters, problem, and events already shown.

items.prompt: Lito's bike has a flat tire and he fixes it. Which ending fits?

options.text: The bike turns into a boat.

items.explanation: After the tire is fixed, the bike works again, so Lito can ride it home. The other endings do not follow from fixing a flat tire.

items.prompt: Which ending follows the events of the story?

options.text: A watered plant stands upright later.

items.explanation: Water makes a dry plant healthy again, so it stands upright later. The other endings do not follow from watering a plant.

items.prompt: The cart's wheel was repaired. Which ending does NOT fit?

options.text: A dragon flies the cart away.
The cart is easy to push.

items.explanation: A repaired wheel lets the cart move again, so the first two endings fit. A dragon flying the cart away does not follow from fixing a wheel.

items.prompt: A seedling is dry and Ana waters it. Which ending fits?
items.explanation: Water helps a dry seedling grow, so it looks healthier later. The other endings do not follow from the story.

items.prompt: Which is a logical story ending?

options.text: A dragon appears for no reason.
A repaired wheel lets the cart move.

items.explanation: Fixing the wheel solves the problem, so the cart can move again. Ignoring the problem or adding a dragon does not make a logical ending.
